stem.text: Two polynucleotide strands make up a DNA molecule.

A.text: The percentage of cytosine is 50% of that of guanine in the whole molecule.

B.text: The percentage of cytosine is the same as that of guanine in the whole molecule.

C.text: The percentage of cytosine is the same as that of guanine in each strand.

D.text: The percentage of cytosine is the same in each strand of the molecule.
